new_law_not_old_cutoff: Each of ALL twelve physical edges has a three-dimensional electric Hilbert space; same local rule on spanning-tree edges and chords. This is a newly defined finite quantum-link Hamiltonian, not a converged rotor or old chord-L1 rename.

local_link.algebra: [E,U]=U exactly; U is NOT unitary, [U,Udagger]=diag(-1,0,+1). Electric-ladder labels are NOT physical photon spin or helicity.

geometry: Vertices lexicographic (x,y,z) in {0,1}^3. Twelve nearest-neighbour edges oriented toward increasing coordinate. B has +1 at source and -1 at target.
matter: Spinful CAR on sixteen ordered modes p=2*site+spin. Full Nup=Ndown=4 sector, 4900 matter basis states, not a one-electron-per-site dynamical restriction. Background b_i=1 at EVERY site; rho_i=n_i-1.
physical_space: ker G with G_i=sum_e B_ie E_e+n_i-1. Enumerate all five chord fluxes in {-1,0,+1}^5 for every Fock state; solve seven tree fluxes uniquely via deleted-row incidence inverse; retain if and only if all seven tree values are in {-1,0,+1}. This enumerates precisely ALL admissible local-edge Gauss states, including all allowed dynamic doublon/holon configurations.

complete_primitives_before_projection.hop: T_e = P[-t sum_sigma c_(b,sigma)^dagger U_e c_(a,sigma)]P for oriented e=(a,b). A complete transition changes n_a by -1, n_b by +1 and ONLY E_e by +1. Target all-edge capacity determines boundary suppression. Literal CAR signs retained.
complete_primitives_before_projection.loop: W_left=P[product_e U_e^(cycle_e)]P, using Udagger for cycle_e=-1. cycle is actual x=0 yz perimeter and B cycle=0. Whole loop product is constructed BEFORE projection, not product(P U_e P). Matter unchanged; every physical E shifts by the complete cycle.
complete_primitives_before_projection.H: sum_e E_e^2/(2I)+U_H sum_i n_iup n_idown+sum_e(T_e+T_e^dagger), t=1,U_H=4,I=1,hbar=charge=spacing=1. No supplied Maxwell B^2/cosine stiffness, imported kernel, external D or fitted speed. At fixed total N=8, U_H/2 sum_i(n_i-1)^2=U_H sum_i doublon_i exactly.

same_primitive_current.matter: dot rho_i=-sum_e B_ie J_e; dot G_i=0
same_primitive_current.electric_energy_power: dot(E_e^2/2)=1/2(E_e J_e+J_e E_e). The expectation is Re<E_e J_e>, NOT <E_e><J_e>. C-even states can have nonzero power while mean E,J,rho vanish.

charge_conjugation.definition: C c_(i,sigma) C^-1=eta_i c_(i,sigma)^dagger, eta_i=(-1)^(x_i+y_i+z_i); C E C^-1=-E; C U C^-1=Udagger. On ordered Fock basis C|bits>=prod_(occupied p)[(-1)^p eta_(p//2)] |complement bits>, with E reversed.
charge_conjugation.half_filled_symmetry: C exchanges up4/down4 occupancies with complements but remains in Nup=Ndown4. Hubbard maps D to 8-N+D=D in this sector. Bipartite hopping, electric energy and Gauss space are C symmetric. C^2=1 checked on retained basis.
charge_conjugation.odd_and_even: rho,E,J are C-odd; E^2, doublon+holon, symmetrized E-J power and J^2 are C-even. C maps doublon to holon, NOT to zero. Zero mean charge therefore does not exclude real neutral pair-energy convection.

fresh_preparation.seed: Product over z dimers (0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7) of (up_a down_b-down_a up_b)/sqrt(2), all E=0. Sixteen literal Fock components, one electron/site, exact spin-singlet product and C eigenvalue +1. Not an eigenvacuum or observed Mott phase.
fresh_preparation.pulse: psi_p=exp[-i alpha (W_left+W_leftdagger)/2] psi_0, alpha=0.7. C-even field-only unitary; no conditioning/postselection. On this seed the loop subspace is {-cycle,0,+cycle}; field factor cos(alpha/sqrt(2))|0>-i sin(alpha/sqrt(2))(|+cycle>+|-cycle>)/sqrt(2).
fresh_preparation.locality: Actual matter factorization residual, C-state residual, initial receiver excess and all-basis source/receiver commutators retained. Initial right electric energy is zero in both states. Full H evolution subsequently permits all charge fluctuations.

receiver_ownership.ER: sum_(e in x=1 yz face) E_e^2/2, disjoint physical support from left pulse
receiver_ownership.HR: r_i=x_i; w_e=(r_a+r_b)/2. HR=sum_e w_e E_e^2/2+4 sum_i r_i doublon_i+sum_e w_e(T_e+T_e^dagger). HL=H-HR. Bridge link energies are split half. Raw HR may be negative; deltaHR/work is redistribution, not monotone efficiency.
receiver_ownership.differences: delta O(t)=<pulse(t)|O|pulse(t)>-<baseline(t)|O|baseline(t)>, both evolved with identical H. All raw values use columns baseline,pulse.

causal_controls.hopping_off: Hoff=HE+4D; HRoff=weighted HE+4Dright. If [Hoff,ER]=[Hoff,HRoff]=[source,ER]=[source,HRoff]=0, initial equal receivers stay equal for the SAME initial states for all t.
causal_controls.path_cut: Hcut=H minus ONLY hopping across four x bridges; electric/Hubbard terms retained. HRcut=HRoff+right-face hopping; HLcut=Hcut-HRcut. Exact [HLcut,HRcut]=[HLcut,ER]=[source,HRcut]=[source,ER]=0 implies entire right trajectory unaffected by left source. Receiver belongs to actual control H, not coupled HR. No re-grounding.

material_discriminator: Track local n, doublon, holon, charge variance <(n-1)^2>, right Hubbard energy, current J^2, sym E-J power and unnormalized ER with no-charge projectors. Snapshot charge-free ER is NOT a history/virtuality discriminator and cannot establish virtual-only radiation.
numerics: Primary actual expm_multiply scaled Taylor at samples t=0,0.5,...,4. Independent global same-H endpoint Chebyshev action uses Gershgorin enclosure and bound |J_n(z)| <= (z/2)^n/n! exp(z^2/(4(n+1))); Bessel-tail bound excludes roundoff, separately measured by endpoint state and receiver differences.
scope: Finite occupied-background neutral energy transport or failure only. No masslessness, physical helicity, two-photon, speed, continuum, rotor convergence, stationary Mott phase, virtual-only, CAR36, Nature or closure promotion.
